preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and isinstance(m, int) and 1 <= n <= 10**9 and 0 <= m <= n for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, n and m are integers where 1 <= n <= 10^9 and 0 <= m <= n.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == total_substrings - zero_substrings(i) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output is the maximum number of substrings containing at least one '1', calculated as total possible substrings minus the maximum possible substrings containing only '0's.
